motion_contract.runtime_model_note: Export-model hashes document kinematic provenance, not an actuator/contact contract; apply and audit the shared validation model settings separately.

limitations: Early termination censors the full-core XY verdict; trajectories are never extrapolated.
Equal numerical PhysX and MuJoCo friction is not physical tire-ground calibration.
This root-XY view does not establish actual wheel-ground patch slip or human GMR feasibility.
One deterministic episode per coefficient; the friction failure boundary needs more seeds or a finer grid.
Pose predicates are recorded but do not terminate this diagnostic; full duration or small XY error alone does not demonstrate controlled upright execution.
Large-angle turning and supplementary S-avoidance are separate task strata; their success rates are not pooled.
